integrity: Exact symbolic characteristic-polynomial identities and 1000-parameter numerical state-spectrum checks are reproducible from verification.py. The analytic proof supplies the infinite-parameter conclusion; finite tests are supplemental.
scientific_limitations: The exact sharp threshold concerns only a fixed rank-one reflector, planar quadratic Morse saddle, and continuous-time heavy-ball flow. No result about coupled or time-dependent subspace dynamics, discrete solvers, nonlinear critical cycles, or higher-dimensional necessity is asserted.
title: A sharp momentum-induced angular instability frontier for planar saddle search
